I checked the draft against the brand policy and found nothing that needs changing.

- **"We started Pebblebrook in Bristol in 2019"** matches the allowlisted claim "Founded in Bristol in 2019" (Companies House).
- **"Our tea bags are plastic-free and home compostable"** uses the allowlisted wording exactly, backed by the EN 13432 supplier certificate.
- **"because we couldn't find tea bags without plastic in them"** is a founding-story motivation. It isn't a statistic, superlative, guarantee, health claim or environmental claim, so it isn't restricted.
- **"here's how we checked"** leads into the rest of the post. When the full post is reviewed, any specifics about how the checking was done should stay within the EN 13432 certificate.
- **Voice:** the tone is warm, plain and unhurried, with UK spelling and no banned phrases.
- **Disclosure:** none is required, because this is our own blog and not a paid or gifted post or an affiliate link.
- **Approval:** per policy, Sam (marketing lead) still signs off on everything public.
